milestones.label: Thesis and ICP locked
milestones.criterion: Idea Anatomy complete, one written ICP

milestones.label: Validating with real growers
milestones.criterion: 8 interviews with owner/decision-makers at Dutch tomato growers, Mom Test, each written up. A WhatsApp reply is not an interview.

milestones.label: The pick works in simulation
milestones.criterion: Perception to plan to pick to crate, recorded, with no hardcoded fruit positions

milestones.label: A validated kg/hr
milestones.criterion: Throughput campaign re-run after the deck camera and the pad-compliance fix, number published with its method

milestones.label: Unit economics on that number
milestones.criterion: Pricing rebuilt on measured throughput instead of a design target

milestones.label: A grower commits on paper
milestones.criterion: Signed letter of intent or a paid pilot

milestones.label: Fundraising started
milestones.criterion: Deck out to 10+ qualified investors and a first meeting taken
